premise: On a foggy morning Sandpiper can't see anything; a chugging shape turns out to be the fishing boat coming home, a bottle rolls up to his feet, and the sun melts the fog away.
inspiration: The fog-and-reveal of sea tales (the ship out of the mist), told with no danger: what was hidden was there all along, and friendly.
lesson: What you can't see is often still there, safe.

en-US.title: The Foggy Morning
en-US.text: {canvas:fog 0.8 30s} [softly] One morning, the beach was hidden in fog, soft and white and grey. {sandpiper:enter} Sandpiper peered out. {sandpiper:face surprised} He couldn't see the water. {sandpiper:live look-around} He couldn't see the lighthouse. [whispers] Where has everything gone? [short pause] {sfx:chug} Chug, chug, chug. Something big was out there. {fishing-boat:enter} A dark shape came slowly through the fog… {fishing-boat:pulse} the fishing boat, coming home. And bobbing along beside it, {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to fishing-boat} a little green bottle. {bottle:go to shore} A wave rolled it right up to the edge. {sandpiper:go to bottle by run} Sandpiper ran over and gave it a peck. {bottle:live pop} Pop! went the cork. {sandpiper:face happy} {sandpiper:live laugh} [laughs] Then, {canvas:sunshine 0.8 25s} slowly, the sun broke through, {canvas:fog stop} and the fog melted away. {fishing-boat:live net} The fishing boat hauled up its net, {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to fishing-boat} and Gull flew out to say good morning. {sandpiper:live peck} Sandpiper pecked happily at the ground. [happily] Everything was right where it had been, all along. {sandpiper:hop}

es-ES.title: La mañana de niebla
es-ES.text: {canvas:fog 0.8 30s} [softly] Una mañana, la playa amaneció escondida en la niebla, suave, blanca y gris. {sandpiper:enter} Correlimos se asomó. {sandpiper:face surprised} No veía el agua. {sandpiper:live look-around} No veía el faro. [whispers] ¿Dónde se ha ido todo? [short pause] {sfx:chug} Chuc, chuc, chuc. Algo grande había ahí fuera. {fishing-boat:enter} Una sombra se acercaba despacio entre la niebla… {fishing-boat:pulse} la barca de pesca, que volvía a casa. Y meciéndose a su lado, {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to fishing-boat} una botellita verde. {bottle:go to shore} Una ola la llevó rodando hasta el borde. {sandpiper:go to bottle by run} Correlimos fue corriendo y le dio un picotazo. {bottle:live pop} ¡Pop!, hizo el corcho. {sandpiper:face happy} {sandpiper:live laugh} [laughs] Entonces, {canvas:sunshine 0.8 25s} poco a poco, salió el sol, {canvas:fog stop} y la niebla se deshizo. {fishing-boat:live net} La barca subió su red, {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to fishing-boat} y Gaviota salió volando a darle los buenos días. {sandpiper:live peck} Correlimos picoteó el suelo, contento. [happily] Todo estaba en su sitio, como siempre. {sandpiper:hop}

ja-JP.title: きりの 朝
ja-JP.text: {canvas:fog 0.8 30s}[softly]ある朝、うみべは、きりにすっぽりつつまれていました。ふんわり白くて、はいいろの、きり。{sandpiper:enter}シギくんが、きょろり。{sandpiper:face surprised}水が、見えません。{sandpiper:live look-around}とうだいも、見えません。[whispers]みんな、どこへいっちゃったの？[short pause]{sfx:chug}ポン、ポン、ポン。なにか、大きなものがいます。{fishing-boat:enter}くろいかげが、きりのなかから、ゆっくり…{fishing-boat:pulse}漁船です。かえってきたのです。そのよこで、ぷかぷかゆれているのは、{bottle:enter}{bottle:go to fishing-boat}小さなみどりいろのびん。{bottle:go to shore}波が、びんを、波打ち際まで、ころころはこんできました。{sandpiper:go to bottle by run}シギくんは、かけよって、コツン。{bottle:live pop}スポンッ！コルクがぬけました。{sandpiper:face happy}{sandpiper:live laugh}[laughs]それから、{canvas:sunshine 0.8 25s}ゆっくりと、お日さまが顔を出して、{canvas:fog stop}きりは、とけるように、きえていきました。{fishing-boat:live net}漁船があみを引きあげると、{seagull:enter}{seagull:go to fishing-boat}カモメさんが、「おはよう！」 といいに、とんできました。{sandpiper:live peck}シギくんは、うれしそうに、足もとをつんつん。[happily]なにもかも、はじめから、ちゃんとそこにあったのです。{sandpiper:hop}

de-DE.title: Der Nebelmorgen
de-DE.text: {canvas:fog 0.8 30s} [softly] Eines Morgens lag der Strand versteckt im Nebel, weich und weiß und grau. {sandpiper:enter} Der Strandläufer lugte hervor. {sandpiper:face surprised} Er konnte das Wasser nicht sehen. {sandpiper:live look-around} Er konnte den Leuchtturm nicht sehen. [whispers] „Wo ist denn alles hin?“ [short pause] {sfx:chug} Tuck, tuck, tuck. Da draußen war etwas Großes. {fishing-boat:enter} Ein dunkler Schatten kam langsam durch den Nebel… {fishing-boat:pulse} das Fischerboot, auf dem Heimweg. Und neben ihm schaukelte {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to fishing-boat} eine kleine grüne Flaschenpost. {bottle:go to shore} Eine Welle rollte sie bis ans Ufer. {sandpiper:go to bottle by run} Der Strandläufer rannte hin und pickte daran. {bottle:live pop} Plopp! machte der Korken. {sandpiper:face happy} {sandpiper:live laugh} [laughs] Dann {canvas:sunshine 0.8 25s} kam ganz langsam die Sonne durch, {canvas:fog stop} und der Nebel löste sich auf. {fishing-boat:live net} Das Fischerboot zog sein Netz hoch, {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to fishing-boat} und die Möwe flog hinaus, um Guten Morgen zu sagen. {sandpiper:live peck} Der Strandläufer pickte fröhlich auf dem Boden herum. [happily] Alles war noch genau da, wo es immer gewesen war. {sandpiper:hop}

fr-FR.title: Un matin dans la brume
fr-FR.text: {canvas:fog 0.8 30s} [softly] Un matin, la plage avait disparu dans la brume, une brume toute douce, blanche et grise. {sandpiper:enter} Bécasseau a pointé le bout du bec. {sandpiper:face surprised} Il ne voyait plus l’eau. {sandpiper:live look-around} Il ne voyait plus le phare. [whispers] Mais où était passé le monde ? [short pause] {sfx:chug} Teuf, teuf, teuf. Quelque chose de gros approchait, là-bas. {fishing-boat:enter} Une ombre avançait lentement dans la brume… {fishing-boat:pulse} c’était le bateau de pêche qui rentrait. Et juste à côté, en dansant sur l’eau, {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to fishing-boat} une petite bouteille verte. {bottle:go to shore} Une vague l’a roulée jusqu’au bord. {sandpiper:go to bottle by run} Bécasseau a couru lui donner un coup de bec. {bottle:live pop} Pop ! a fait le bouchon. {sandpiper:face happy} {sandpiper:live laugh} [laughs] Puis, {canvas:sunshine 0.8 25s} tout doucement, le soleil a percé, {canvas:fog stop} et la brume s’est envolée. {fishing-boat:live net} Le bateau de pêche a remonté son filet, {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to fishing-boat} et Mouette est allée lui dire bonjour. {sandpiper:live peck} Bécasseau a picoré par terre, tout content. [happily] Rien n’avait bougé : tout était là depuis le début. {sandpiper:hop}

it-IT.title: Una mattina di nebbia
it-IT.text: {canvas:fog 0.8 30s} [softly] Una mattina, la spiaggia era nascosta nella nebbia, morbida, bianca e grigia. {sandpiper:enter} Piovanello ha fatto capolino. {sandpiper:face surprised} Non vedeva l'acqua. {sandpiper:live look-around} Non vedeva il faro. [whispers] Dov'è finito tutto quanto? [short pause] {sfx:chug} Tuf, tuf, tuf. Laggiù c'era qualcosa di grosso. {fishing-boat:enter} Un'ombra scura avanzava piano nella nebbia… {fishing-boat:pulse} era il peschereccio, che tornava a casa. E accanto a lui, dondolando, {bottle:enter} {bottle:go to fishing-boat} c'era una bottiglietta verde. {bottle:go to shore} Un'onda l'ha fatta rotolare fino alla riva. {sandpiper:go to bottle by run} Piovanello è corso lì e le ha dato una beccata. {bottle:live pop} Pop! ha fatto il tappo. {sandpiper:face happy} {sandpiper:live laugh} [laughs] Poi, {canvas:sunshine 0.8 25s} piano piano, è spuntato il sole, {canvas:fog stop} e la nebbia è svanita. {fishing-boat:live net} Il peschereccio ha tirato su la rete, {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to fishing-boat} e Gabbiano è volato fin lì a dare il buongiorno. {sandpiper:live peck} Piovanello becchettava contento per terra. [happily] Tutto era al suo posto, proprio dov'era sempre stato. {sandpiper:hop}

zh-TW.title: 起霧的早晨
zh-TW.text: {canvas:fog 0.8 30s}[softly]有一天早上，整片海灘都躲進了霧裡，白白的、灰灰的、軟綿綿的。{sandpiper:enter}濱鷸探出頭來看。{sandpiper:face surprised}牠看不見水。{sandpiper:live look-around}也看不見燈塔。[whispers]大家都跑到哪裡去了呢？[short pause]{sfx:chug}噗、噗、噗。外面有個大大的東西。{fishing-boat:enter}一個黑黑的影子，從霧裡慢慢地出來了……{fishing-boat:pulse}是漁船，它回家了。在它旁邊，一搖一晃地漂著{bottle:enter}{bottle:go to fishing-boat}一個綠色的小瓶子。{bottle:go to shore}一道浪把它推呀推，一直推到水邊。{sandpiper:go to bottle by run}濱鷸跑過去，啄了它一下。{bottle:live pop}啵！軟木塞跳開了。{sandpiper:face happy}{sandpiper:live laugh}[laughs]接著，{canvas:sunshine 0.8 25s}太陽慢慢地露出臉來，{canvas:fog stop}霧就這樣不見了。{fishing-boat:live net}漁船拉起了網子，{seagull:enter}{seagull:go to fishing-boat}海鷗也飛過去，跟大家說早安。{sandpiper:live peck}濱鷸開心地在地上啄呀啄。[happily]原來，每樣東西都好好的，一直都在原來的地方。{sandpiper:hop}

zh-HK.title: 大霧的早上
zh-HK.text: {canvas:fog 0.8 30s}[softly]一天早上，沙灘藏在大霧裏，白白的，灰灰的，軟綿綿的。{sandpiper:enter}濱鷸探頭出來看看。{sandpiper:face surprised}牠看不見水。{sandpiper:live look-around}牠看不見燈塔。[whispers]所有東西都去了哪裏呢？[short pause]{sfx:chug}噗、噗、噗。霧裏面，有甚麼大東西來了。{fishing-boat:enter}一個黑影穿過大霧，慢慢駛過來……{fishing-boat:pulse}原來是漁船，正要回家。在它旁邊一浮一浮的，是{bottle:enter}{bottle:go to fishing-boat}一個綠色的小瓶子。{bottle:go to shore}一個浪把它一直推到岸邊。{sandpiper:go to bottle by run}濱鷸跑過去，啄了它一下。{bottle:live pop}啵！瓶塞彈了出來。{sandpiper:face happy}{sandpiper:live laugh}[laughs]然後，{canvas:sunshine 0.8 25s}太陽慢慢露出臉來，{canvas:fog stop}霧一點一點地散了。{fishing-boat:live net}漁船拉起了網，{seagull:enter}{seagull:go to fishing-boat}海鷗飛過去跟它說早晨。{sandpiper:live peck}濱鷸開開心心地啄着地面。[happily]原來，每樣東西一直都在那裏，從來沒有走開過。{sandpiper:hop}

chug.prompt: a small fishing boat's old engine chugging slowly across calm water, distant, realistic

pop.prompt: a cork popping out of a glass bottle, a gentle pop
